nodes.description: Ownable._owner: privileged owner address set in the Ownable constructor and read by owner() and _approve().
Ownable.newComer: address initialized to _msgSender() at deploy time and used by the onlyOwner modifier, decoupled from _owner.
GZLR._balances: mapping of holder balances updated in the constructor and _transfer().
GZLR._allowances: nested mapping written in _approve() (including the forced reset to 0).
GZLR._tTotal: fixed total supply returned by totalSupply().
GZLR._name: token name returned by name().
GZLR._symbol: token symbol returned by symbol().
GZLR._decimals: token decimals returned by decimals().
GZLR constructor: mints _tTotal to _msgSender(), initializes _balances and inherits Ownable ownership setup.
GZLR._approve: private approval routine that zeroes allowances when the owner argument is not owner(), emitting a misleading Approval event.
GZLR.approve: external ERC20 approve forwarding _msgSender(), spender and amount to _approve().
GZLR.transfer: external ERC20 transfer from _msgSender() to recipient via _transfer().
GZLR.transferFrom: external ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens then re-approves the remaining allowance through _approve().
GZLR._transfer: internal balance bookkeeping using SafeMath sub/add and Transfer event emission.
GZLR.allowance: view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
GZLR.balanceOf: view returning _balances[account].
GZLR.totalSupply: view returning _tTotal.
Ownable.owner: view returning _owner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0).
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner to newOwner.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: requires newComer == _msgSender() to guard privileged functions.
Context._msgSender: internal view returning msg.sender.
Address.sendValue: internal function performing a value-bearing low-level call to an arbitrary recipient.
Address._functionCallWithValue: private function executing an arbitrary low-level call with value after isContract check.
Address.functionCallWithValue: internal wrapper validating balance and delegating to _functionCallWithValue.
Address.isContract: extcodehash-based check used before low-level calls.
SafeMath.add: overflow-checked addition producing local c.
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div: division with zero-check.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller identity used for ownership, approvals and transfers.
Unsafe operation in _approve: _allowances[ol][tt] = 0 silently destroys allowances of any non-owner address.
Unsafe low-level value call recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue enabling reentrancy on the caller.
Unsafe low-level call target.call{value: weiValue}(data) in Address._functionCallWithValue with attacker-controlled target and data.
Unsafe operation in _transfer: chained subtraction and addition of _balances entries via SafeMath.
_transfer parameter sender: source address of the balance movement.
_transfer parameter recipient: destination address of the balance movement.
_transfer parameter amount: quantity subtracted from sender and added to recipient.
approve parameter spender: address receiving the allowance.
approve parameter amount: allowance value forwarded to _approve.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner: address assigned to _owner.
SafeMath.add local variable c holding the overflow-checked sum.

edges.reason: Context._msgSender returns the raw msg.sender value.
Constructor obtains the deployer via _msgSender for the initial mint.
Constructor credits _tTotal to the caller address supplied by msg.sender.
Constructor writes the initial balance into _balances.
Constructor chain sets the privileged _owner state variable.
newComer is initialized from the deployer context used during construction.
onlyOwner modifier reads newComer as the effective owner check.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted caller msg.sender against newComer.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner argument flows into transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into the privileged _owner variable.
owner() returns the value of _owner.
_approve compares the allowance owner argument with owner() to branch behaviour.
Caller identity msg.sender is passed as the owner argument ol into _approve.
spender argument becomes the tt parameter of _approve.
amount argument is forwarded into _approve.
_approve executes the forced zero-reset of allowances for non-owner addresses.
The allowance reset writes into the _allowances mapping.
_approve mutates _allowances entries.
approve delegates its logic to _approve, inheriting the reset behaviour.
spender parameter is consumed by approve.
amount parameter is consumed by approve.
transfer calls the internal _transfer routine.
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender of the movement.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance update.
transferFrom re-enters _approve, triggering the allowance reset path for non-owners.
_transfer reads and writes entries of the _balances mapping.
sender parameter drives the debited balance slot.
recipient parameter drives the credited balance slot.
amount parameter bounds the balance movement.
_transfer performs the balance subtraction/addition operation.
Untrusted amount parameter is the operand of the balance subtraction.
The computed values are stored back into _balances.
_transfer relies on SafeMath.sub for the sender balance decrement.
_transfer relies on SafeMath.add for the recipient balance increment.
Local variable c holds the SafeMath.add result.
sendValue reaches the raw low-level value call to the recipient.
The recipient arbitrary code callback can re-enter sendValue's caller before state finalization.
_functionCallWithValue reaches the low-level call with value and attacker-influenced data.
The target contract callback can re-enter while the low-level call executes.
functionCallWithValue delegates execution to _functionCallWithValue.
_functionCallWithValue validates the target with isContract before calling.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter has no independent security meaning outside the balance update performed by _transfer.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful as the credited slot inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is only used as operand of the SafeMath operations inside _transfer.
The spender parameter is purely an argument carrier for approve and its downstream _approve call.
The amount parameter is purely an argument carrier for approve and its downstream _approve call.
The newOwner parameter exists only to be written into _owner by transferOwnership.
The local accumulator c is the internal result of the SafeMath.add addition and has no standalone role.
